items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: No, I used to know, I knew where he was living at though.

ctx.x: Somebody told me that Tony Jackson, the piano player and singer played there. Did you ever hear Tony Jackson? I think he left here when you were very young. I thought you might have heard him.

No, I used to know, I knew where he was living at though. He was living around there, right around the corner from there, what I'm talking about. He was living on the corner I think. Corner in Hillary.
Did you ever hear another fellow, Alfred Wilson, a piano player in the district on Basin Street there? It was way back maybe around 1910 to 15 along that period.
